plugins.name: superuser
plugins.description: SuperUser — a team lead agent. Sizes the task and picks a budget, briefs every piece, dispatches low-effort subagents in parallel, scores them, and re-checks with a fresh reviewer until done. Optional modules (shared context, logs, learning loop, inbox, hook gates) switch per project. Install alone, or extend it with a domain plugin via dependencies.

plugins.name: software-company
plugins.description: Complete software development company in one plugin — 39 agents (core SDLC team plus AI, security operations, mobile, data, compliance, growth, games, IoT, blockchain, reverse engineering and an engineer, a compliance officer and an analyst per industry: fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, insurance, legal tech, SaaS), 113 skills and 29 slash commands. Industry add-ons are merged in since v2.0.0.

plugins.name: trading-finance
plugins.description: Trading and personal finance toolkit for Thai investors — watchlists, signals, paper trading, trade journal, position sizing, dividends, budgets and scam checks, plus Thai money skills: investment tax, year-end deduction planning (/tax-plan), mutual funds, retirement, debt payoff and คลินิกแก้หนี้, insurance review and emergency funds. Uses whatever market-data plugins you already have.

plugins.name: personal-life
plugins.description: Personal life admin for busy adults — weekly reviews, meeting prep and summaries, inbox triage, important documents with expiry dates, travel checklists, gifts, a decision journal, subscription audits from Thai bank statements, scam defence, goals and habits, polite Thai-English messages, home and family, health organising, career, and learning (learning paths, papers to code, tech radar, certification prep, side projects, thesis writing). Works alongside email, calendar and note plugins.

plugins.name: thai-workplace
plugins.description: Thai workplace toolkit for SMEs — LINE OA and chatbots, business documents (quotations, สารบรรณ letters, contracts), PDPA, VAT and withholding tax with a filing calendar, payroll and 50 ทวิ, social security, e-Tax Invoice, year-end DBD and corporate tax, Labour Protection Act basics, PromptPay QR and public holidays. General information only, not legal or tax advice.

plugins.name: e-commerce
plugins.description: Online buying and selling toolkit for Thailand, both sides in one plugin — sell on Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop, LINE and Facebook (listings, fees and pricing, one stock sheet, chat replies, live-selling scripts, couriers and COD, returns) and buy with confidence (decision matrix and total cost, fake-review check, warranty registry, complaint letters up to OCPB hotline 1166, refunds and chargebacks). General information only, not tax or legal advice.

plugins.name: graphic-design
plugins.description: Creative design beyond product UI — brand kits, AI image and video briefs with style consistency, social media format systems, campaign asset sets, motion basics for non-designers, and a critical design-review checklist. Complements image/video generation plugins by adding the design knowledge layer on top.

plugins.name: reverse-engineer
plugins.description: Reverse-engineering toolkit that mirrors the REA architecture — one entry skill routes to per-target modules (JavaScript/Electron apps, native binaries, .NET assemblies, websites, Android APKs), every conclusion must carry evidence and stated limitations, and findings end in an explanation or a rebuildable implementation. Uses the REA engine (npx rea-agents) when available, with manual static-analysis fallbacks. For software you own or are authorized to examine only.
